description: This file defines classes for extending grain state with versioning metadata and ETag support for Orleans-based log storage, enabling log-view consistency and version control.

classes.name: LogStateWithMetaDataAndETag<TEntry>
classes.description: Extends grain state with versioning metadata and ETag for log-view consistency in Orleans grains.

classes.name: LogStateWithMetaData<TEntry>
classes.description: Represents log state with versioning and write vector metadata, supporting duplicate append prevention.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the LogStateWithMetaDataAndETag object, including version, flags, ETag, and log data.

methods.name: GetBit
methods.description: Retrieves the bit for a specified replica from the write vector.

methods.name: FlipBit
methods.description: Toggles the bit for a specified replica in the write vector and returns the new state.
